title: Large-Scale Bidirectional Training for Zero-Shot Image Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using Gender Error and Term Ratio (measuring incorrect gender term usage and the ratio of female-to-male terms), VADER Sentiment Score (comparing the neutral sentiment rate of generated captions across gender groups), and Leakage for Image Captioning (LIC) (training a classifier to predict gender from captions after explicitly removing gender terms).
Evaluated using VADER Sentiment Score to compare the neutral sentiment rate and emotive language used in generated captions across seven different race and ethnicity groups.
